name: M5.Connectivity.divisor_moebius
statement: ∀ n : ℕ, (∑ d ∈ n.divisors, ArithmeticFunction.moebius d) = if n = 1 then (1 : ℤ) else 0
guidance: Rewrite the divisor sum using the reverse of ArithmeticFunction.coe_zeta_mul_apply, then coe_zeta_mul_moebius and one_apply. This is also true for n=0; no positivity assumption needed. Return tactic lines only, without a leading by; preserve exact target.
